searchText: wait, what is the `wallet_` namespace about? The idea is to create a new JSON-RPC method namespace that is for calls that Ethereum clients wouldn't implement, but wallets would. `wallet_signTransaction`, `wallet_sendTransaction`, etc. would go there. And we would deprecate `eth_signTransaction` and `eth_sendTransaction` and other methods that are meant for wallets (the thing that holds user private keys and can sign stuff with them). It's a good idea We've had that goal for a long time, but it turned out very difficult `eth_fillTransaction` was introduced for that reason, to perform all the defaults-setting steps the node can do while not actually signing It's supposed to be an off-ramp for users of `eth_sendTransaction` We later kind of gave up and added external signer support in geth, because people didn't stop using sendTransaction but we didn't want the keys in the node anymore The biggest challenge is that wallets are very uncoordinated compared to client dev teams. However, that isn't a good reason to continue to have the clients implement JSON-RPC methods that are really only for wallets. How about an official spec from us with tests and all? Judging by the last couple years of progress, we are actually getting way better at this coordination/spec process for the RPC API
